title: Product identity, Related products, Internal category and details editor
summary: Port the SKU-first tenant identity header (exact name, retained literal code, one editable Unit with reusable global UnitConversion and per-product override), image-owned exact-SKU artwork action, capability-gated Price/lot/stock directly under Unit, inline Related products picker, Internal category, Requested personalisations, exact order history, bottom grid Stats, Details & changes and archive/restore boundary. Classification and links never replace the tenant record or become manual placement.
steps: Read and edit the exact tenant SKU, retaining original source name, code and mapped Unit data plus field-level before/after history.

Render reviewed artwork per exact SKU as its image-owned ≥44 px Upload/Replace pencil action, with no visible Illustration field/editor while retaining durable artwork provenance. Render Related products as an inline direct picker of deliberately linked existing catalogue records, each a coded SKU or accepted uncoded sale item, followed by reviewable Internal category. Category co-members do not appear as related products; a library/category/related-product image never looks approved for this SKU.

Apply unit-lock, archive, restore, dirty-draft, conflict and permission policy at the command boundary. This Product/Stock correction is UI-only: artwork/provider, classification/model and other AI runtime work remain deferred; the image action is a reviewed seam, not a runtime claim.

positive: Saving a permitted name, code, description, unit or scoped alias creates one revisioned SKU event and leaves old documents unchanged; the order-review Product Sheet shows literal source identity before Related products and Internal category, reviewed per-SKU art and exact row-linked history without flattening records.
negative: An Internal category/group, Related-products link, reference class, equal-name row, generated illustration or archived record cannot become substitute SKU identity, look like approved artwork or silently merge records.

doneConditions: PRD-N01–N06 and PRD-D01–D05 have a named port, status copy, accessible name, and failure/recovery test.
requiredEvidence: Product edit, archive/restore, duplicate-code review, literal-unit preservation, reviewed-art association, Internal category/Related-products independence and conflict-drive results.

title: New product, list intake and existing-product relation
summary: Implement manual identity confirmation and file-or-paste list review in one recoverable creation flow. Add one is identity-only (Product name/SKU/Unit); Add a product list is a collective Product name/SKU/Unit plus Include/Skip readback. Internal classification is a quiet later Product Sheet suggestion/default; only the reviewed inline Related products picker may write a direct relation between existing records.
steps: Offer Add one product and Add a product list inside the same task frame. A list has one source surface: Drop an Excel or CSV file or Paste a product list. It has no column mapping, Placement, category picker or Related-products candidate before results.

Persist original wording/session locator separately from a versioned editable interpretation/review result. List review uses one ordered queue with Ready for input, Reading source, Review needed, Ready, Save failed and Added recovery states.

Use an idempotent reviewed confirmation to create the stable SKU. Ordinary creation/import has no Placement, category picker or Related-products candidate. The inline Related products picker may write one explicit direct link after both records already exist; it never opens a creation route or creates an SKU.

Keep every duplicate-SKU source row separately reviewable. A duplicate canonical SKU blocks confirmation until the operator corrects or skips the affected row; never merge it automatically. Keep recurring requested preparation and brochure options as candidate notes until an operator explicitly approves scoped product creation; none becomes an SKU by recurrence.

Implement UTL-N01–N10 manual identity, required SKU and Unit; canonical SKU storage trims outer whitespace, compares case-insensitively, and preserves internal punctuation and leading zeroes. One-product review stays identity-only; bulk rows show/edits only Product name/SKU/Unit plus Include/Skip, while Internal category/artwork/source remain later Product Sheet context. Preserve deliberate existing-related-product picker, file-or-paste return and draft recovery.

Commit SKU/provenance under one creation request; retry or unknown-outcome lookup returns the same SKU. A Related products link is a later separate reviewed command between existing records. Artwork failure never rolls back or duplicates an admitted SKU. Pricing/stock remain absent until their independent gates.

positive: A Related products selection writes one RelatedItemLink between two existing catalogue records only. Each endpoint retains its own identity and history; a coded endpoint retains its own SKU and artwork state, while an accepted uncoded endpoint remains uncoded and neutral.
An operator can create or import a product with Internal category Not organised without changing the existing SKU, stock, tariff, ERP item or customer document.
A supported file and pasted list share one result queue; a no-history product can be confirmed with an required Unit value and immediately opened as its own Product Sheet.
A later Edit related products decision changes only the selected direct relation and leaves both endpoint identities and kind-eligible facts independent; it cannot create or promote either record.
negative: A candidate, typed description, file/paste, automatic result, source grouping, repeat click or similar display name cannot create stock, price, a relation or a duplicate SKU without review or skip.

No ordinary list item shows a Related-products candidate; recurrence, preview, missing ERP mapping or local panel cannot auto-create a SKU, turn a note into a relation/variation or imply customer acceptance.
Pricing cancel, artwork failure or partial browser-store write cannot create a second SKU or silently discard original code text.

doneConditions: PRD-C01 nested paths cover single product; file list; pasted list; item correction/skip; ready/attention/partial/unavailable/source-unavailable/save-failed/retry; duplicate-SKU correction/skip; dirty navigation; no-placement/no-auto-relation; existing-related-product picker; and return-path recovery.
JNY-P01–JNY-P02 and JNY-O05 retain their candidate/note distinctions, explicit approval, no-auto-SKU and independent-product-scope tests.
requiredEvidence: Idempotent single/file/paste creation suite with queue-state trace, source-custody result and exact new-SKU route trace.
Deterministic Internal-category/artwork-status review fixture, unavailable-review proof, direct-relation creation/edit trace, no-ordinary-related-candidate assertion and safe exact-Albarán use trace.
Candidate-adoption and product-option traces proving recurrence remains a note until explicit scoped approval.

title: Product tariffs, price editor, and independent history
summary: Wire the full production price domain to dated tenant/SKU/tariff price events with exact unit/currency semantics, independent histories, customer overrides, and conflict-safe save behavior. The order-review profile keeps this capability designed but disabled until its own commercial evidence gate passes.
steps: Resolve active tariff and exact SKU before displaying current value, unset state, suggestion, or history.
Validate positive finite currency values, explicit unit, expected revision, and atomic percentage relationship before write.

Provide one accurate state for saving, accepted, conflict, denied, failed, and offline-request intent; gate every price control, display and albaran-value consequence behind the release-profile commercial capability so order review has no active price/tariff action or value claim.

positive: When commercially enabled, a saved price changes only the selected SKU/tariff series and preserves each historical point.
negative: A missing price cannot display as zero, a related SKU cannot write a value, a conflict cannot last-write-wins silently, and the order-review profile cannot expose a dormant price feature as active.

doneConditions: PRD-P01–P06 and customer override controls have independent-tariff, empty, conflict, archive, and keyboard tests.
requiredEvidence: Tariff history drive, percentage atomicity test, failed-save draft preservation trace, and profile-gate proof that order review has no active pricing/value surface.

title: Product stock, lots, and expected-state clarity
summary: Wire the full production inventory domain to receipt, physical count, variance, lot, planning-rule, and history records while preserving the distinct meanings of recorded stock, expected delivery, daily estimate, predicted demand, reservation, allocation, dispatched, and available-to-promise. The order-review profile keeps this capability designed but disabled until independent inventory evidence exists.
steps: Expose recorded balance only from receipt/count/adjustment evidence and label absent evidence as Still to record.
Record receive and count as separate idempotent commands with count variance and reviewed lot deductions.
Keep daily estimates and model forecasts in non-physical planning projections with explicit time, source, and non-promise copy.

Expose **Assign stock to lots** only for a fixed Recorded balance; it reattributes physical stock between named lots and Unassigned stock with zero net change, never an albarán allocation or delivery promise. Gate stock, lot, supplier-intake and availability surfaces behind the release-profile inventory capability; order review retains source/order facts without presenting inventory as active.

positive: When inventory is enabled, a physical count of zero persists as zero, a receipt adds stock, and a lot reduction remains traceable.
negative: A scheduled estimate, supplier expectation, forecast, or related product cannot alter recorded balance or claim available-to-promise without a stated rule; order review cannot imply that a disabled inventory domain has been activated.

doneConditions: PRD-S01–S06 and the named **Assign stock to lots** route cover receipt, zero count, variance, partial lot traceability, planning stop, stale revision, and failed-save recovery.
requiredEvidence: Stock receipt/count/variance drive, lot-allocation test, expected-state copy audit, and profile-gate proof that order review has no active inventory/supplier-intake surface.

title: Product order and source-evidence panels
summary: Connect exact-SKU operational orders, historical order/source evidence, pagination, unavailable-source state and native-provider return paths without inheriting category/group, Related products or sender-name-only records. Supplier intake remains a separately gated inventory capability; Product Sheet shows only compact exact-SKU Source evidence.
steps: Query exact SKU ID against current/order-history projection with state-specific counts.

Resolve inbound WhatsApp/email/source cards through explicit exact-SKU evidence links and preserve the native provider return target; do not treat a Product Sheet as a local mailbox, customer-reply transport or supplier inbox. The separately gated Stock update owns a supplier/source feed.
Page long sets with visible load, failure, retry, and complete-count state.

positive: Opening a related order or inbound source message returns to the same exact SKU and preserves its context, including the native provider handoff.
negative: An Internal category/group, Related-products neighbour, sender name, missing source, truncated page or disabled supplier-intake feature cannot be represented as exact-SKU evidence.

doneConditions: PRD-O01–O02 and PRD-E01–E04 have exact-scope, empty, unavailable, pagination, and navigation tests.
requiredEvidence: SKU evidence linkage test, paginated-history test, unavailable-source recovery trace, and native-provider-return proof.

title: Product insights and customer-price doors
summary: Build the product insight projection from completed exact-SKU lines. The order-review profile enables quantity/order-count/customer evidence and accessible chart/table drilldown; customer-price doors remain a full production capability designed but disabled until commercial evidence exists.
steps: Aggregate only completed exact-SKU quantity, order-count and customer facts over an explicit date window and tax basis; revenue/value projections require the separately enabled commercial capability.
Render numeric table equivalents for charts and explain empty/one-observation states without synthetic trends.
When the commercial capability is separately enabled, open customer price editing with the customer/SKU/tariff scope visible at every confirmation step; otherwise expose no price-edit door.

When customer confirmation is separately enabled, present its Product Sheet door as a scoped policy entry point without presenting it as a customer message or price result; the order-review profile exposes no outbound confirmation control.
Implement UTL-I01–I05 chart cards, subtle section grid, exact SKU/tariff/date drilldown and accessible evidence table; sparse evidence never fabricates series.

positive: Order-review quantity, count and customer bars reconcile to their underlying completed exact-SKU line items.
When enabled, the product context exposes the customer-confirmations policy summary and opens its named settings surface without changing tariff, customer override, recipient or document.
negative: Category/group or Related-products buyers, forecasts, decorative values, revenue in the order-review profile, or an empty Explore action cannot appear as measured product insight.
Opening a dormant door or reading a summary cannot accept a price, bypass Operations authority, send a chat confirmation, or imply that a customer saw a quote.

doneConditions: PRD-I01–I05 have reconciliation, empty, one-observation, accessible-chart, and override-scope tests.
JNY-C01 has state-summary, accessible-name, shared-modal/history restoration, no-side-effect and tenant-scope tests.
requiredEvidence: Quantity/count/customer insight reconciliation report and accessible table test; commercial/revenue fields remain absent in order-review proof.
Scoped commercial-door trace across enabled and order-review-disabled states with in-place restoration and no outbound message request.

title: Product artwork sheet controls
summary: Connect the SKU artwork entry, request intent, upload candidate, review, assignment, retry, and archive states to the separate image-job contract without claiming a provider result early.
steps: Show the SKU-owned asset association and latest approved candidate independently from Internal-category/group or Related-products presentation art.
Submit request intent and validated candidate upload through durable review records.
Surface requested, queued, submitted, candidate, approved, rejected, failed, unavailable, and retryable states honestly.

positive: An approved candidate is assigned only to its reviewed SKU and retains provenance.
negative: A local request, provider-unavailable state, Internal-category/group or Related-products asset, or pending replacement cannot masquerade as an approved new image.

doneConditions: PRD-A01 state transitions, upload validation, review, archive restriction, and last-approved fallback are tested.
requiredEvidence: Artwork-state drive, candidate validation result, and review audit trace.

title: Customer identity, contact, and relationship sheet
summary: Implement the customer record and sheet with durable identity, contacts, addresses, customer aliases, tariff context, active work, editable fields, dossier, archive, and return behavior.
steps: Define stable customer identity, contact methods, address, status, tariff, and scoped alias relationships.
Provide a customer editor with field validation, draft recovery, expected revision, and explicit archive/restore consequences.
Open customer records from orders, product insights, map, and search without replacing the originating object context.
Implement CUS-E01–E07 fields, transport-specific validation, explicit duplicate choice, tenant-scoped stable creation request and acknowledged persistence before list publication.

positive: A customer update is scoped to one tenant/customer and appears with actor and revision in its dossier.
negative: Creating, editing, or archiving a customer cannot overwrite another customer, a product alias, or an earlier order snapshot.
Legacy unscoped data, name matching, failed persistence or unknown coordinates cannot leak/merge/invent customer facts.

doneConditions: Customer identity/contact/editor/archive states have field, permission, conflict, and origin-return coverage.
requiredEvidence: Customer lifecycle drive, dirty-form recovery test, and related-object navigation trace.

title: Customer current work, prices, and dossier insights
summary: Build the Customer Sheet's decision-first order work, product memory, customer-price actions, chronological history, and evidence-backed insights without treating an inference as a current commercial fact.
steps: Order customer content as current work, upcoming/in-flight, historical documents, and compact supported insights.
Scope product and tariff choices to the exact customer and permitted role.
Show unknown, no history, loading, provider unavailable, and stale projections with accurate recovery copy.

positive: A customer-price change affects only the selected customer/SKU/tariff and retains history.
negative: A profile can neither invent a preference nor use a future observation to explain a historic order.

doneConditions: Current-work, history, insights, price override, empty, unavailable, and access-denied states are all driven.
requiredEvidence: Customer price scope test, chronological dossier test, and insights evidence trace.

title: Customer address, map, zone, and route controls
summary: Implement address validation, provider-backed place selection, route/zone assignment, map state, fallback, and manual correction without converting a suggested location into a delivery commitment.
steps: Persist normalized address plus original input, provider result state, and manual override reason.
Calculate zone and route suggestions as reviewable operational facts under effective policy.
Render provider loading, unavailable, denied, out-of-zone, stale, and manual-entry states without a fake map result.

positive: A permitted correction records the exact customer address and recomputes future route projections.
negative: A map suggestion, geocode failure, or route grouping cannot claim a delivered address or rewrite issued documents.

doneConditions: Address, provider outage, manual fallback, zone conflict, and mobile map controls have contract tests.
requiredEvidence: Address-provider contract test, manual fallback trace, and route-policy projection result.

title: Customer source, relationship, and operational notices
summary: Add customer-scoped source evidence, supplier/customer notices, and action history with explicit scope, consent, and review rather than a generic customer intelligence feed.
steps: Link source records to customer decisions with explicit capability and provenance.
Separate proposal, accepted action, dismissed notice, provider receipt, and unavailable-source state.
Expose customer-visible versus internal evidence through role-aware projections.

positive: A permitted notice links back to its exact source and current resolution state.
negative: A supplier fact, model inference, or unrelated conversation cannot become a customer claim without reviewed scope.

doneConditions: Source scope, notice state, dismissal/reopen, and customer visibility tests are green.
requiredEvidence: Customer notice audit trace and source-linkage test.

title: Order and albarán identity, state, and document snapshots
summary: Establish the authoritative order/albarán lifecycle, daily numbering, current-work projections, commercial state transitions, and immutable issued snapshots.
steps: Define order, albarán, line, current-work, cancel, correction, issue, and reprint lifecycle events.
Allocate tenant/day document numbers atomically and retain frozen document revision references.
Project queues and counts from authoritative state rather than client-side flags.
Derive Sales filter/counts and own-day order selection from current actor account/line scope and frozen order identities.

positive: An issued document retains its customer, SKU, unit, price, total, and revision snapshot after later edits.
A salesperson can reopen an assigned order and return to the same permitted Sales scope/count basis.
negative: A duplicate day number, client-computed queue, or later catalogue change cannot rewrite a prior issued albarán.
A cached filter, same route or similar customer cannot expose or count an unassigned order.

doneConditions: Lifecycle, numbering, current-work, cancellation, snapshot, and replay tests pass.
requiredEvidence: Order-state transition suite, daily-number concurrency test, and document replay report.
Two-salesperson scoped-filter/count/order-return/revocation trace at 1280×800, 390×844 and 320×740.

title: Albarán lines, units, prices, and totals
summary: Port the full production line domain for SKU resolution, written phrase, quantity, Unit, rate, tax, packed quantity, lot, note, and calculated total to exact-decimal server commands. The order-review profile enables an unvalued line grammar: exact match, field-check, off-SKU provisional acceptance/rejection, and multiple-exact-SKU choice; price, total and lot controls remain disabled until their independent domains are proven.
steps: Separate quantity, Unit, rate, total, packed amount, and lot fields in commands and accessible labels; order review exposes only literal/exact SKU resolution, quantity, unit, approved note and optional final-weight fields.

Render the active unvalued grammar explicitly: normal exact line; normal line with a red outline/underline only around an ambiguous or abnormal field and its local reason; faded italic off-SKU literal row with accept-as-one-off or reject actions that never create a SKU; compact multiple-choice hybrid when several real SKUs match, with no invented top candidate.
Calculate totals server-side from exact decimals, price source, currency, tax, and frozen unit revision only when the commercial capability is enabled; otherwise render neither rate nor total.

Require explicit conversion and reconciliation policy before changing a commercial unit or applying a price; expose JNY-R05 actual quantity/unit-price/weight fields only when working-paper/commercial correction capability is separately enabled.

positive: In order review, accepting an exact line, field correction, off-SKU one-off, or a selected real SKU preserves literal source wording, actor, revision and unvalued quantity/unit facts.

When commercial correction is enabled, a permitted line correction accepts one exact actual quantity/unit price under the matching review/print baseline and preserves the before/after commercial facts.
negative: A client total, unknown unit equivalence, sibling tariff, per-kilo rate, or one-off acceptance cannot be silently carried into a different Unit or create a tenant SKU.

A photo, field label, unit mismatch, stale baseline, client total, ambiguity highlight, or multiple-choice presentation cannot globally reprice, infer a lot/unit, alter tariff history, fabricate a top candidate, or claim final paper.

doneConditions: Every active order-review line control has an exact command, source/evidence, error, conflict, unit and narrow-layout test; full commercial/inventory controls retain their own gated tests.

Exact/field-check/off-SKU/multiple-choice cases have desktop and mobile accessibility, provenance, accept/reject, no-auto-SKU and no-fake-candidate tests; JNY-R05 retains actual-field tests when separately enabled.
requiredEvidence: Order-review line-state matrix with exact/field-check/off-SKU/multiple-choice provenance and unvalued-render proof; unit-mismatch and accessibility audit.
Working-paper actual-field command trace with baseline, revision conflict and no-global-tariff mutation proof when that capability is separately enabled.

title: Albarán source provenance, concerns, and corrections
summary: Make source evidence, uncertainty, concern lifecycle, corrections, approvals, dismissals, and reopening observable at one exact source card, field, product row or contiguous row group. The full Albarán and condensed order-in-chat use one red boundary and local dismissible reason; native handoff never sends outward.
steps: Draw one red boundary around the exact source card, field, full product row or contiguous row group; put one short dismissible colleague-style reason immediately above it, with no floating note or generic score.

On relevant edit or sent message, re-evaluate only that scope: resolve, replace or dismiss a stale reply note and optionally show a brief dismissible acknowledgement while retaining the earlier reason and outcome in disclosure history.
Use the same scope/reason/lifecycle in the composer tray and condensed order-in-chat card; failed saves, unrelated edits and navigation leave the concern active.
Render choice ambiguity as a compact question/product hybrid with clear options that reflows to a normal product row on selection; render off-SKU grey italic with Accept once, Edit and Reject.

Implement JNY-R01–JNY-R03 and JNY-O01–JNY-O04 as revisioned paper-source/concern and Team-note/customerOption review states, preserving literal evidence, scope, approved audience and no direct mutation; an order-review reply tray opens the matching native WhatsApp/email thread and cannot send through Rocoto.

positive: A reopened concern or reply-attention retains its original evidence and shows the later resolving or dismissal act.
A permitted reviewer can retain a proposed substitute, approval request/receipt and later final-document revision as distinct linked events when the separately enabled domain permits it.
A permitted reviewer can retain paper/photo and Team-note/customerOption evidence separately, then make an explicit scoped review/approval whose source, actor, time and revision remain attributable.
negative: A confidence score, generic explanation, unrelated source, or model output cannot auto-resolve, reprice, mutate an albarán, or replace a reasoned reply attention with a generic flag.
A similarity match, pending/denied/expired customer approval or stale document revision cannot auto-substitute, finalise, present a replacement as delivered, or hide a multiple-SKU choice.
A local photo, recurrence, raw note, missing source, stale review, unapproved audience or reply tray cannot apply an actual, resolve a concern, create a SKU or send outward customer text.

doneConditions: Line/order concern, source span, local field outline, reply-attention reason/dismiss/reopen/native-handoff, correction, and role-visibility test coverage is complete.
JNY-02 substitution proposal, customer-approval, expiry, stale-revision and no-final-issue cases pass when that domain is separately enabled.
JNY-R01–JNY-R03 and JNY-O01–JNY-O04 have stage/source/retry, review/approval/remove, audience/source/actor/time, conflict, accessibility and no-outward-leak tests.
requiredEvidence: Concern/reply-attention lifecycle test, provenance snapshot, custom-dismissal/native-handoff proof, and correction audit trace.
Substitution source/proposal/customer-approval/document-revision audit trace when separately enabled.
Paper/source and Team-note/customerOption lifecycle trace proving no automatic correction or outward text without scoped acceptance.

title: Albarán commands, issue flow, and customer document view
summary: Wire make, validate, issue, reprint, amend, archive/cancel, compose, and document preview controls to the immutable output contract and appropriate permissions.
steps: Validate required commercial, legal, stock, and permission facts before issue.
Create an immutable document revision, offer preview/reprint against that revision, and record amendment links.
Use state-specific copy for draft, validating, issued, queued, receipt received, failed, and unknown outcome.
Implement JNY-O06 customer document composition as an approved-customerOption filter, excluding prepNote/raw/unreviewed text across confirmation, customer paper and issued output.
Require current scoped order authority before a salesperson prepares own-day customer document output or cross-cover work.

positive: An authorized issue command produces one immutable revision and a retrievable audit entry.
A customer-facing document projection includes only a matching approved customerOption snapshot and retains its document/policy revision.
An authorised scoped document review retains only the selected order revisions and customer-view policy.
negative: A preview, queue submission, client button, or later edit cannot prove issue, print, delivery, or customer receipt.
Internal preparation text, raw request, unapproved option or later option edit cannot leak into customer output or rewrite issued/sent content.
A cross-cover proposal, stale scope or client selection cannot issue a document for an unassigned customer.

doneConditions: Every albarán primary/menu action has an authorized port, exact copy, state model, and success/failure evidence.
JNY-O06 has approved/missing/remove, confirmation/paper/ERP exclusion, issued-snapshot and accessibility/copy tests.
requiredEvidence: Issue/reprint/amendment test, immutable snapshot hash, and permission-denial test.
Customer-output composition trace proving approved option inclusion and prepNote/raw-note exclusion.
Scoped output/cross-cover permission-denial and stale-revision trace.

title: Albarán navigation, query, and deterministic test theatre
summary: Preserve document origin and browser history, build proper sales search, and isolate test/roleplay scenarios from live transport, provider calls, and business projections.
steps: Address routes by stable order/document/source IDs and restore the actual origin on Back/Forward.
Index tenant-authorized orders, customers, products, and source summaries through a controlled search API.
Namespace deterministic test data and prohibit outbound transport, provider claims, and live projection contamination.

positive: A test scene produces a repeatable local result with visible test lineage and no outbound receipt.
negative: A missing deep-link target, test control, or search result cannot silently substitute another order, source, or live transport.

doneConditions: History, deep-link recovery, scoped search, fixture reset, and no-outbound test-theatre tests pass.
requiredEvidence: Route recovery test, test-lineage trace, and transport-denial log.

title: Money, tax, unit, and price-resolution authority
summary: Create the server-side decimal money, tax, unit-equivalence, price-source, effective-date, and manual-pin rules used consistently by product, customer, order, document, and export commands.
steps: Use exact decimal storage and calculation with currency/unit on every displayed commercial number.
Resolve price using tenant, SKU, tariff, customer override, effective time, unit, and authorized manual pin.
Reject unknown or incompatible equivalence rather than converting by guesswork.
Resolve pinned line > valid customer exact-SKU override > assigned tariff under unit/currency/effective policy; review affected drafts while preserving all issued/sent/output snapshots.

positive: The same authorized inputs resolve the same price source and server total across sheets and exports.
negative: Float rounding, client totals, retired tariff reuse, or unit inference cannot change an issued commercial result.

doneConditions: Decimal, effective-time, unit, pin, tax, and cross-sheet price-resolution tests pass.
requiredEvidence: Money/unit property suite and price-resolution trace.

title: Company tariff registry and commercial-policy controls
summary: Implement the tenant tariff registry, retirement, customer allocation, price policy, unit policy, and effective-dated commercial settings without reopening historic commercial facts.
steps: Create/reorder/rename/retire tariff identities with affected-record preview and audit.
Set commercial approval and unit/equivalence policy with explicit effective time.
Preserve historical tariff IDs and price series after relationship retirement.

positive: A permitted tariff retirement keeps prior prices and documents readable while blocking new allocation.
negative: A registry edit cannot silently reprice products, merge tariffs, or erase a customer's historical allocation.

doneConditions: Registry lifecycle, effective-date, authority, and affected-record tests are green.
requiredEvidence: Tariff lifecycle test and commercial-policy audit report.
